references.text: Introduces Micah from the hill country of Ephraim, which is the place the Danites pass through in 18:13
Describes the Levite who came to Micah's house in the hill country of Ephraim, the same place mentioned here
The five scouts from Dan had previously come to Micah's house, and now the entire tribe returns to the same place
Continuation of the journey where they enter Micah's house after arriving there in verse 13
The hill country of Ephraim is mentioned as a geographical area in Israel, the same region through which the Danites travel
Joshua's inheritance was in the hill country of Ephraim, the same mountainous region that the Danites pass through on their way to Micah's house
